sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: A release page (Tracklist or Credits) marks a ℗ notice in its annotation that no relationship backs: a line that starts with ℗, (P) or "Phonographic copyright", as on a sleeve ("℗ 1973 CBS, Inc."), is tinted light yellow with a ⚠️ when neither the release nor any of its recordings has a phonographic copyright relationship. Hovering (or tapping) it explains why and shows the holder as read. The ⚠️ list shows it first, under "This release", with the table warnings under "In the tables"; clicking it opens the Annotation, scrolls to the line and flashes it. A ℗ on even one recording is enough, © lines are not checked, and nothing is flagged while some of a long release's tracks are not on the page. No requests: it reads the page's own data. The rule and the notice parser are majkinetor's Group Therapy (credited); its own tint switch, ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ Findings → "Highlight ℗ notices in a release's annotation that no relationship has as WARNING" (on).
